hints.title: Bézout Identity for Linear Combinations of Capacities
hints.text: Any measurable quantity formed by pouring and emptying containers must equal an integer linear combination a * x + b * y.

hints.title: Divisibility by Greatest Common Divisor
hints.text: The target volume target can be achieved if and only if it does not exceed the combined capacities x + y and is divisible by gcd(x, y).

hints.title: Closed Form GCD Test
hints.text: If target > x + y return false. If target is 0 return true. Return target % math.gcd(x, y) == 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal logarithmic solution computing GCD via Euclidean algorithm.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first state graph exploration takes O(X * Y) time and space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Number theoretic characterization solves the reachability in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should mention Bézout identity and correctly bound target <= x + y.
